params.name: q
params.description: Location query. Accepts: city name, lat/lon, US zip, UK postcode, Canada postal code, METAR code (metar:EGLL), IATA (iata:DXB), auto:ip, IPv4/IPv6, or location ID (id:2801268).

params.name: dt
params.description: Date on or after 2010-01-01 in yyyy-MM-dd format.

params.name: unixdt
params.description: Unix timestamp equivalent of `dt`. Do not pass both.

params.name: end_dt
params.description: End date for range (Pro+ and above). Max 30 days range. yyyy-MM-dd.

params.name: unixend_dt
params.description: Unix timestamp equivalent of `end_dt`. Do not pass both.

params.name: hour
params.description: Restrict output to a specific hour (0–23) in 24-hour format.

params.name: aqi
params.description: Include Air Quality Index (AQI) data in response.

params.name: pollen
params.description: Include pollen data. Available on Pro+ and above.

params.name: tp
params.description: Interval for data. Use tp=15 for 15-minute intervals (Enterprise only).

params.name: lang
params.description: Language code for condition text. E.g.: fr, de, es, zh, ar. See full list in docs.

params.name: solar
params.description: Include solar irradiance data in History API. Enterprise only.

params.name: et0
params.description: Include evapotranspiration data. Business and Enterprise only.

params.name: wind100mph
params.description: Include wind speed at 100m height in mph. Enterprise only.

params.name: wind100kph
params.description: Include wind speed at 100m height in kph. Enterprise only.

items.docs: Returns historical weather data for a given date on or after 1 January 2010. Includes hourly breakdown. Enterprise plan unlocks solar irradiance, wind@100m, pollen history, and evapotranspiration.
